Bombay High Court cancels bail for Shiv Sena corporator in doctor assault case

The Bombay High Court has cancelled the bail of Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre, who was arrested in connection with an assault on doctors. Following the court's order, Mhatre was re-arrested. The incident has led to Maharashtra doctors announcing a strike on July 20.
